title: Customer Service Representative - Cali Sur
fit_note: Local entry-level opening. Strong transferability; direct call-center experience is not listed as required.
job_description:
TaskUs — Customer Service Representative - Cali Sur
Location: Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia. Entry level, full time.

Responsibilities:
- Receive inbound and/or place outbound calls.
- Provide accurate and timely responses through email and live chat.
- Manage and resolve customer complaints professionally according to client quality guidelines.
- Protect customer satisfaction and the overall customer experience.

Requirements:
- Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills focused on issue resolution.
- Exceptional verbal and written communication in English.
- Willingness to work shifting schedules.
- Ability to multitask with close attention to detail.
- Readiness to participate in formal training and continuous self-improvement.

title: Bilingual Customer Service Representative
fit_note: Local role with transferable communication and documentation work. Fluent English and previous service experience are selection risks and must not be overstated.
job_description:
Bush & Bush Law Group — Bilingual Customer Service Representative
Location: Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia. Full time.

Responsibilities:
- Manage incoming calls, emails, and messages and respond accurately and on time.
- Gather and document essential client information regarding legal cases.
- Help clients navigate their cases by providing updates and process information.
- Resolve concerns professionally and empathetically, escalating complex situations when needed.
- Support data entry, scheduling, and organization of client files.

Qualifications:
- Fluent English and Spanish.
- High school diploma or equivalent; some college preferred.
- Previous customer-service experience, preferably in a legal or office environment.
- Strong verbal and written communication and a customer-centric approach.
- Microsoft Office proficiency; case-management software is a plus.
- Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time in a fast-paced environment.
- Empathy, patience, and a positive attitude.

title: Python Developer
fit_note: Strong match: production Python, Django, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Git and CI/CD are verified. pytest and GraphQL remain unclaimed unless evidenced.
job_description:
Hired — Python Developer
Location: Colombia, fully remote. Full time, mid-level.

Key responsibilities:
- Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.
- Write clean, well-tested code following modern Python practices.
- Design and implement RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
- Optimize performance and resource usage across services.
- Collaborate with product, data, and infrastructure teams.
- Contribute to code reviews and engineering documentation.

Required skills:
- 2+ years building production Python applications.
- Strong Django, Flask, or FastAPI knowledge.
- PostgreSQL or a similar relational database.
- Cloud services such as AWS or GCP and Docker containerization.
- Git, CI/CD, and modern testing frameworks such as pytest.
- Pragmatic decisions balancing speed and quality.

Additional qualities:
- Strong written communication and ability to explain technical decisions.
- Curiosity, test-and-learn mindset, and comfort working asynchronously across time zones.

title: Desarrollador(a) Full Stack Python + React
fit_note: Buen ajuste técnico. La formación solicitada es tecnólogo o profesional; el CV conserva el título técnico real para que el reclutador decida la equivalencia.
job_description:
SETI S.A.S — Desarrollador(a) Full Stack Python + React
Ubicación: Colombia. Modalidad remota. Contrato a término indefinido.

Requisitos indispensables:
- Tecnólogo o profesional en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Software o carreras afines.
- Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.
- Experiencia comprobable con Python usando FastAPI, Flask o Django.
- Experiencia comprobable con React.
- Desarrollo de aplicaciones web empresariales de mediana y alta complejidad.
- Consumo e integración de APIs REST y metodologías ágiles.

Conocimientos técnicos:
- React, JavaScript o TypeScript, HTML5 y CSS3; Angular deseable.
- Python indispensable; Java/Spring Boot, .NET/C# o Node.js son valorados.
- SQL Server, PostgreSQL y MySQL; MongoDB deseable.
- AWS indispensable: EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda y API Gateway.
- Git, Docker, CI/CD, SonarQube, pruebas unitarias y de integración.
